name: export_document
description: Export the active document to HTML, Markdown, or PDF format with sandbox security gating. Renders the in-memory session state (includes unsaved execute_batch edits, not the last saved file); success returns {ok:true,format,path|content,bytes,dirty,revision,imageMode,assetPrefix,assets,assetCount} (dirty:true = unsaved edits present). For Markdown exports, images default to extracted files in a unique generation within a sibling <doc_basename>_assets/ directory when outPath is specified; in-memory exports default to embedded base64 data URIs. PDF renders via headless LibreOffice: a ~11s first-render cold start is expected behavior, not a bug. Failures return {ok:false,code,message,remedy}.

sessionId.description: Active document session ID returned by open_document

outPath.description: Optional output destination path (must reside inside allowed directory)

imageMode.description: Markdown only: "file" requires outPath and writes image assets under a unique generation in sibling <doc_basename>_assets/; "embed" uses base64 data URIs. Default is "file" with outPath and "embed" otherwise.

assetPrefix.description: Markdown only: relative directory prefix for extracted image assets (default: "<doc_basename>_assets")

strict.description: PDF only: fail closed on preflight blockers (default false, warn-only)
